description: Stateless duplicate removal for text lists and CSV/TSV rows with the removeduplicates.org engine. Text is processed in memory for each call and never stored.

tools.name: remove_duplicates
tools.title: Remove duplicates
tools.description: Remove duplicate lines from a text list, or duplicate rows from CSV/TSV text such as rows copied from Excel or Google Sheets. Uses the same engine as removeduplicates.org and returns the cleaned text with counts. Stateless: the text is processed in memory for this call only and is never stored.
